notes.title: Shu's Garden 2.4 Is Out!
notes.content:
Shu's Garden 2.4 is now available, featuring:
[list]
[*]Performance improvments.
[*]Corrections to localisations.
[*]New insect life!
[/list]

Grab a couple controllers and come chill in the space-garden with Shu and her friends!

notes.title: Split-Screen Multiplayer!
notes.content:
At long last, version 2.3 of Shu's Garden adds [b]split-screen multiplayer[/b]. Grab an extra controller or three on PC/Mac and go gardening with your friends!

[b]Play as any character in the garden[/b], including Shu's various space-cactus friends, a hypersonic bee, a giraffe, a flappy happy bird, and a wise sea turtle.

The game is designed to work with Xbox-style controllers out of the box, but you can configure controls and other advanced settings by holding alt/option while starting the game.
